name: Agentic Security Review
summary: Review the composed attack surface of an agentic system against OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications (ASI01-ASI10): data reach, tools as privileges, delegated authorization and agent identity, memory and context poisoning, and tool/skill/MCP-server provenance, with a plan-only adversarial test design and HARD-gate challenges that only a principal's decision record with a risk acceptance reference can override.
security_notes: Static review only; adversarial tests are designed, never run; no credentials, tokens, signing keys, or customer data are requested or echoed. ASI mappings are candidate review aids, not certification. HARD-gate challenges are overridable only by a principal-sourced decision record carrying a risk acceptance reference.
